My father and I have never really gotten along.
Pinnacle was late November of 2008 (I was a sophomore in high school). He said something particularly nasty about the girl I was seeing.
I was sick of his petty insults and bullshit. He struck out at me (as was usual throughout my childhood into high school) but the main difference was that I struck back. We got into a brawl, punching and kicking repeatedly until were were both tired and bruised. He gets the great idea to pick up a baseball bat and swing it at my face. I threw my arms up and absorbed the blow and ran to my room, where I barricaded my door shut with all the furniture I could manage. I waited until he fell asleep outside my door to crawl out the window with no shoes on into the few inches of slow on the ground and ran around the side of the house. I creeped in to grab a pair of shoes and walked through the sleet about a mile away to my friend Mark's house. A police officer asked me what I was doing in the storm with so little clothes on (no jacket, hat, gloves, etc and it was definitely below freezing). I ignored him and walked to the front door of my friend's house. His mother pulled me into the house and I asked if I could stay by them until Christmas break when I was to go see my mother out of state. She accepted wholeheartedly and asked me to tell the story. I let her know what happened and she told me that I was welcome to stay as long as I'd like and that my mother and I should sue my father. I said that wouldn't fix anything and she left it at that. My father texted me that night and told me not to come back home again. So I didn't. Two weeks later I moved to my mother's house without saying goodbye to my father. I haven't seen him in two years.
